annotations.text: Both artboards are live. Left: type in the composer (or hit a suggestion) — the turn goes silent while the prompt is read, the tool card opens, the answer streams, and the reasoning folds into 'Thought for N words'. Theme button is bottom-left. Right: Allow or Deny the destructive command.
Values lifted from symbio_desktop/static/style.css, not approximated: #c15f3c / #d97757 accent, 260px sidebar, 6/10/16/22px radii, 15px base, 720px thread column, 32px send button, 1.62 line-height.
